facts.text: Ines finds the lighthouse clock stopped, so the lamp does not turn; Tomas follows her up
facts.when: The first cold morning of the year

anchor.quote: the hands stood at ten minutes to six

facts.text: The keeper's rule: the lamp turns when the clock strikes the hour, and a keeper who breaks it loses the tower

anchor.quote: People in Kessel called it the keeper's rule

members.name: The keeper's rule
members.definition: The lamp turns when the clock strikes the hour; a keeper who breaks it loses the tower

facts.text: Ines Varga, the keeper's daughter, holds the key to the clock room while her father is away

anchor.quote: He had left the key to the clock room with her

facts.text: Tomas says nothing when Ines says that somebody stopped the clock

anchor.quote: Tomas looked at the floor and said nothing
Her younger brother, Tomas, followed her up

facts.text: Mr Hale warns that the keeper will lose the tower if the clock is not running by Friday, and will not help

anchor.quote: her father would lose the tower and the house

facts.text: Mr Hale is the harbour master

anchor.quote: Mr Hale, the harbour master, was already angry

facts.text: Without the light, three boats cannot come into the harbour

anchor.quote: none of them would come in without the light

facts.text: Ada, a clockmaker, arrives on the late evening boat and agrees to mend the lighthouse clock for the compass of Ines's mother

anchor.quote: she had come to Kessel to repair the church clock

facts.text: Ada Moreau is a clockmaker from the city, come to repair the church clock
Ines gives her mother's brass compass, the only valuable thing she owns, because she cannot pay Ada's price

anchor.quote: It was the only valuable thing she owned

facts.text: Mr Hale asks Ada about the church clock and does not mention the lighthouse

anchor.quote: He did not mention the lighthouse

facts.text: Ines gives Ada the key to the clock room and watches her lamp climb the tower

anchor.quote: That night Ines gave Ada the key to the clock room

must_carry.text: The keeper's rule: the lamp turns on the clock's hour, and a keeper who breaks it loses the tower
must_carry.question: What is the keeper's rule in Kessel?

must_carry.question: How does Tomas react when Ines says somebody stopped the clock?
